title: InfraDev: Can Coding Agents Develop AI Infrastructure, and How Can We Tell?
abstract: arXiv:2610.36589v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are beginning to develop the production-grade AI infrastructure that trains and serves large models, yet existing benchmarks cover only single kernels or single-GPU tasks, and grade with tests and prompts that misjudge both correct and incorrect patches. We introduce InfraDev, a benchmark of 36 tasks built from real-world pull requests to Megatron-LM, vLLM, and verl, covering infrastructure development for training, inference, and reinforcement learning. Each task asks an agent to reimplement a real change that spans many files and must run correctly across many GPUs. To grade such changes, we jointly synthesize hidden probes, which enforce the requirements the original tests leave unchecked, and a prompt that states every interface the probes call without revealing the solution. We also design a shared execution environment that reuses dependencies and artifacts across tasks, cutting storage by 52-57% and build time by 13-

translated_title: InfraDev：编码智能体能开发AI基础设施吗？我们又该如何评判？
translated_abstract: 编码智能体已开始参与开发现代AI基础设施的生产级代码——这些基础设施负责训练和服务大型模型，然而现有基准测试仅覆盖单个内核或单GPU任务，且其评分所用的测试与提示会同时误判正确的补丁和错误的补丁。我们提出了InfraDev，这是一个包含36个任务的基准测试，基于针对Megatron-LM、vLLM和verl的真实pull request构建，涵盖训练、推理和强化学习的基础设施开发。每个任务要求智能体重现一个跨越多个文件、且必须在多个GPU上正确运行的真实变更。为了给这类变更评分，我们联合合成了隐藏探针与提示词：隐藏探针用于强制检查原始测试未覆盖的需求，提示词则声明探针所调用的每个接口但不泄露解决方案。我们还设计了一个共享执行环境，可在任务之间复用依赖项和构建产物，将存储占用降低52-57%，构建时间降低13-
tldr: InfraDev是一个基于Megatron-LM、vLLM和verl真实代码变更构建的36任务基准，用于评估编码智能体开发多文件、多GPU的AI基础设施代码的能力，并通过隐藏探针和共享执行环境实现更准确高效的评分。
en_tdlr: InfraDev is a 36-task benchmark built from real pull requests to Megatron-LM, vLLM, and verl that evaluates coding agents on multi-file, multi-GPU AI infrastructure development, using jointly synthesized hidden probes and a shared execution environment for more accurate and efficient grading.
